'''Gutodj''' was a [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who worked on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wielu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On Wielu, Gutodj sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] from a stall in an area known as the [[Market Ward]] where the Chevin would cry out advertising its wares. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Rook Pryce]] approached Gutodj about buying a new blaster from the merchant, but the Chevin informed him that the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime bosses]] that controlled much of Wielu had forbidden anyone from doing business with the untrustworthy smuggler. This ban extended to Pryce's new co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], Sal'ma Ben Bobo, who was in fact the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise, and the Chevin refused to even give them information as to where the [[Shistavanen/Legends|Shistavanen]] criminal [[T'mott Zoat]] was. As the pair left Gutodj warned Kenobi to not trust Pryce, due to his history of not honoring contracts. Gutodj had [[Color/Legends|blonde]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], green skin and whilst at the market wore a brown [[Clothing/Legends|robe]].<ref name="SC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gutodj first appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]'', a digest sized [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] released in [[2013]]. It was written by [[Justin Aclin]] and illustrated by [[Eduardo Ferrara]].
